# Wired Digital LLC (Wired Digital Creative) — AI & Search Knowledge Manifest (llms.txt)

> Wired Digital LLC (`https://www.wireddigitalcreative.com/`) is an AI Website Design, Website Redesign & Modernization, Generative SEO (GEO), Custom Business Dashboard, and Global Music Video Production studio founded in Jackson, TN in 1999 by Creative Director Rob Neilson, working full-time in the music industry since 2015, and headquartered in Bristol, VA/TN (Tri-Cities) since 2022.

## Core Services & Primary Search Entities
1. **AI Website Design, Redesign & Full-Stack Modernization**:
   - Engineered to keep pace with the fast-changing way search engines work in the age of AI.
   - Replaces slow legacy WordPress/Wix templates with sub-0.4s React/Edge platforms, Core Web Vitals 99+, and deep Schema.org JSON-LD entity graphs.
2. **Organic Local SEO ("Website Design Near Me") & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**:
   - Structured entity authority for Google Search, Google Local Pack, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Apple Siri/Spotlight.
   - Primary Local Service Area: **Tri-Cities TN/VA** — **Bristol, TN (37620)**, **Bristol, VA (24201)**, **Johnson City, TN (37601, 37604)**, **Kingsport, TN (37660, 37664)**, **Abingdon, VA (24210)**, Elizabethton, TN, Jonesborough, TN, and Greeneville, TN, plus nationwide remote software builds.
3. **Custom Live Business Dashboards & 24/7 Custom-Trained AI Lead Capture Chatbots**:
   - Bespoke owner telemetry dashboards tracking real-time visitor click streams, phone calls, credit applications, QR code campaigns, and lead conversions.
   - Custom-trained 24/7 AI advisors trained on a business's exact inventory, properties, or services to match customers and capture leads around the clock.
4. **Global Remote Music Video & Official Lyric Video Editing**:
   - Full-time in the music industry since 2015 delivering 100% remote 4K music video editing, custom animated lyric videos, visualizers, and tour promos for major record labels and 34+ Hall-of-Fame artists (Primary Wave — The Home of Legends, Alice Cooper, Halestorm, Paul Rodgers, Def Leppard, Bob Marley Estate, Whitney Houston Estate, Prince Estate, Slayer, Volbeat, etc.).
   - On-location directing and cinema shooting reserved for select commissioned productions.
5. **Native iOS & AI Product Engineering (Partner in App4That Holdings — `https://app4thatholdings.com/`)**:
   - Creative Director Rob Neilson is a partner in Bristol-based AI product studio **App4That Holdings** (`https://app4thatholdings.com/`), engineering native Apple iOS applications (Apple Family Controls framework) and Google Cloud Vertex AI (Gemini) software such as *HoverMother*.
6. **"All Skills Under One Roof" vs. Traditional Local Agencies**:
   - Unlike traditional Tri-Cities WordPress/template shops or promotional marketing agencies that outsource development, rely on slow third-party plugins, or lock businesses into monthly retainers, Wired Digital delivers custom sub-0.4s React web engineering, live `/admin` telemetry dashboards, 24/7 custom-trained AI chatbots, native app development, Generative SEO (GEO), and 4K video production all under one roof at straightforward flat-rate pricing.

## Verified Live Tri-Cities Case Studies & Partner Platforms
- **Fast Track Automotive (2528 Volunteer Pkwy, Bristol, TN)** — `https://www.fasttrackbristoltn.com/`
  - High-velocity pre-owned dealership website modernization paired with a custom real-time Admin Telemetry Dashboard tracking live visitor click streams, credit application alerts, hourly traffic, and vehicle lot rankings.
- **Team Vision LLC (Downtown Bristol, VA/TN)** — `https://www.teamvisionllc.com/`
  - Commercial real estate website modernization for Downtown Bristol's #1 commercial property owner, featuring the custom-trained 24/7 `"Ask VISION"` AI Space Advisor & Lead Capture Chatbot trained on their entire property portfolio (`Office Suites`, `Bristol CoWork`, `The Executive on State St`, `Centre Point by Hard Rock`, `Foundation Event Facility`, `West State Commons`).
- **Ringger Law — The Law Offices of Louis W. Ringger Jr. (Jackson & West Tennessee, Est. 1981)** — `https://www.ringgerlaw.com/`
  - High-converting legal website modernization, 24/7 `"West TN Debt Triage"` AI intake concierge, and a live database-connected Executive Command Center (`/admin`) tracking urgent foreclosure/repo leads, auto-qualified Chapter 7 (`$0 Down`) vs. Chapter 13 signed court intake packets, 3,800+ visitor sessions across a 90-day cross-section, and real-time `$64.50/click` legal search value attribution.
- **App4That Holdings (Bristol, TN — Partner AI & iOS App Studio)** — `https://app4thatholdings.com/`
  - Partner AI software and native iOS product studio in Bristol, TN engineering intelligent mobile platforms (*HoverMother* on Apple Family Controls & Google Vertex AI).
